trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The program has no verification stage, no completeness check, no early-exit condition, no deduplication, and no relevance filter.
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including key documents about Al-Ghazali, Averroes, and The Incoherence of the Philosophers. Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents (mostly duplicates). Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents (mostly duplicates). The output contains all necessary evidence to verify the claim.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents containing all necessary information to verify the claim (Al-Ghazali as Persian theologian author, death dates showing 87-year gap not 13). The summarizer correctly identified the factual error in the claim. The query generator for hop 2 produced a query seeking confirmation of the death date discrepancy, which retrieved largely duplicate documents. The query generator for hop 3 produced a broad keyword query that also retrieved duplicates. All three retrievals completed and 24 documents were returned as specified. The summaries correctly identified that sufficient evidence was already present after hop 1, but the pipeline correctly continued to complete all three hops as required by its specification. No steps failed to execute, no structural obligations were violated, and the output format matches specification.
